subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration and SDK changes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration and SDK changes

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery + next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) Key pain points you stated
- High latency on semantic search / embeddings at scale (90% of queries under 300ms target)
- Need reliable reranking pipeline to surface top results without blowing up token costs
- Current UI requires structured JSON outputs for attribute extraction and downstream tooling
- Desire to evaluate streaming responses and function-calling for a smoother live search experience

2) Goals and success criteria
- Pilot: 50k queries/day with median latency <300ms and p95 <600ms
- Quality: reranking improves top-3 precision by at least 8-10% vs current heuristic
- Integration: SDK to support server-side function calling + streaming and structured output from model responses

3) Product fit / integration notes we discussed
- Recommend Redwood embeddings + in-service reranker (embedding + fast rerank) to minimize reshuffle costs
- SDK changes: short-lived streaming client + function-calling helper in our Node SDK; sample PR will include a streaming example and structured-output schema enforcement
- Structured outputs: suggest using our JSON schema validation helper (we showed the demo of schema-anchored outputs)

4) Risks / open questions
- Data residency / logging retention — we should confirm retention window and any audit log requirements before the pilot
- Quotas and burst capacity during search spikes (we can propose burst policies on Dedicated if needed)

5) Next steps / owners
- I’ll send the post-call PDF recap and an integration plan (attached).
- Jonas: will prepare a technical deep-dive and SDK sample PR for function calling + streaming by 2026-08-24.
- Vivek: will provide latency benchmarking data for our recommended model variants and quantization profiles by 2026-08-25.
- Alex / Sanjay: confirm pilot scope and access for a 2-week PoC environment by 2026-08-21.

Attachments: redwood-integration-recap.pdf, mvp-integration-plan.xlsx

If that matches your read, can we lock a technical deep-dive next Tuesday (08/24) at 10am PT?

Best,

Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration and SDK changes

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligned with our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Priority order: 1) embeddings + reranking (search relevance), 2) structured outputs for attributes, 3) streaming for live UX.
- Budget: we have an initial pilot budget scoped at ~$30k for the PoC. We’ll need an estimate for expected token/compute spend for the pilot (50k q/day, expected per-query token avg ~600 tokens across embed + rerank).
- Compliance: Sanjay asked to confirm that audit logs (who queried what) can be retained for 90 days and that we can disable logging of PII at ingestion. Please confirm.

We can do the technical deep-dive Tue 08/24 10am PT — that works for me. 

On the attachments, could you surface the sample telemetry/latency numbers in the integration plan? That will help our infra team sign off.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the SDK PR and PoC environment details.

—Alex
Principal Product Manager, Search
Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: Redwood integration and SDK changes

Jonas / Vivek — 

Looping you in with Alex’s clarifications. Action items below: 
- Jonas: prioritize a Node SDK sample PR showing function-calling + streaming (small demo + README). Target: 2026-08-24.
- Vivek: run a quick baseline for the embedding+rerank flow (50k q/day sim) and include median/p95 numbers, plus expected cost delta for quantized model variant. Target: 2026-08-25.
- I’ll draft a short pilot cost estimate for the ~$30k budget and include expected token counts.

Keep this thread updated as you push the PR / benchmark docs. I’ll confirm the deep-dive invite for 08/24 10am PT once Jonas confirms availability.

Thanks —
Marissa
